children: Boohoo's sale of the Nasty Gal fashion brand seems another excellent deal, as the company works to strengthen its balance sheet, Panmure Liberum analysts write in a note. The retailer, which trades under the Debenhams Group name, said it completed the sale to WSG Brands for $16 million. The brand was a noncore asset and didn't sit within the company's Youth Brands business, Wayne Brown and Anubhav Malhotra say. "Two deals in two weeks and we have a very different looking balance sheet," they say. Last week, the company said it sold its Sheffield distribution center. The stock trades 0.6% higher. (andrea.figueras@wsj.com)
